title: Dr. Willem Kolff: The Father of the Artificial Kidney
lineage: Notes paraphrase selected source passages; not a source copy.

passages.note: The review describes Kolff and Hendrik Berk’s artificial kidney in 1943 and the recovery of a patient in 1945. Earlier human dialysis work existed. Case details and dates vary between retrospective sources; survival of one patient is not an estimate of treatment effectiveness.
